description: This file provides utility functions and type definitions for handling Android native buffers and hardware buffers within the ANGLE project, including conversions between different buffer types, querying buffer properties, and mapping pixel formats to OpenGL formats.

classes.name: android_native_base_t
classes.description: Structure representing a reference-counted native base object with incRef and decRef methods.

classes.name: ANativeWindowBuffer
classes.description: Structure representing an Android native window buffer, including properties like width, height, format, and a handle to the native buffer.

methods.name: ClientBufferToANativeWindowBuffer
methods.description: Converts an EGLClientBuffer to an ANativeWindowBuffer pointer.

methods.name: GetANativeWindowBufferProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as width, height, depth, and pixel format from an ANativeWindowBuffer.

methods.name: NativePixelFormatToGLInternalFormat
methods.description: Maps Android hardware buffer pixel formats to corresponding OpenGL internal formats.

methods.name: ANativeWindowBufferToAHardwareBuffer
methods.description: Converts an ANativeWindowBuffer to an AHardwareBuffer pointer using pointer offset.

methods.name: AHardwareBufferToClientBuffer
methods.description: Converts an AHardwareBuffer to an EGLClientBuffer using pointer offset.
